description: This file defines the FileStreamOptions class for configuring file streaming options in Apache Spark, including parameters like max files per trigger, max bytes per trigger, file age, and cleanup modes.

classes.name: FileStreamOptions
classes.description: Class for managing user-specified options for file streaming in Spark, including validation and parsing of parameters.

classes.name: CleanSourceMode
classes.description: Enumeration for specifying how to clean up completed files in file streaming (archive, delete, off).

methods.name: checkDisallowedOptions
methods.description: Validates that disallowed options are not set in the parameters.

methods.name: withBooleanParameter
methods.description: Helper method to parse boolean parameters with default values.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a string option to a CleanSourceMode enumeration value.
